segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Welcome to all of you . .. can everybody see and hear me? . ..

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Good . ..

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: I'm Sally, your guide for this tour of the Bicentennial Park . ..

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: I hope that you're all wearing your most comfortable shoes and that you can keep up the pace.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: So let's get under way on our tour around this wonderful park.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: I'll start today with some general background information.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: There used to be a lot of factories in this area until the 1960s.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Creating the park required the demolition of lots of derelict buildings on the site, so most of the exciting park space all around you was originally warehouses and storehouses.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The idea of building a public park here was first discussed when a property developer proposed a high-rise housing development, but the local community wasn't happy.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: If the land was to be cleaned up, they wanted to use the site for recreation.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Residents wanted open space for outdoor activities, rather than housing or even an indoor sports complex.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Now to the Bicentennial Park itself.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: It has two areas, a nature reserve and a formal park with man-made features and gardens.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The tall blue-and-white building in front of us is called The Tower and is the centre point for the formal gardens.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: It stands twelve metres high, so follow me up the stairs to where we can take advantage of the fantastic views.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Well, here we are at the top of The Tower, and we're going to look at the view from each direction.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Out to the east, the large buildings about a kilometre away are on the Olympic site.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: There's an indoor arena for gymnastics, a stadium for track and field and a swimming pool for races and synchronised swimming and also diving.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: If you look carefully down there, you can see the train lines.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The Olympic site has its own station to encourage the use of public transport.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: There is also a car park, but it only holds a limited number of cars.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The formal park has some specially-created water features.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: If you look out here to the south, you can see a circular ornamental pond.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: And around to the west, you can relax and sit on a bench to smell the flowers in the rose garden, and finally up to the north, if you look in front of you now, there's a lake with a small island in the centre, you can hire rowing boats at the boat shed, which you can't see from here, - but if you look through the trees, you can see the cafe, which has lovely views across the water.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: OK, let's climb down now.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: We will go now and have a look at the nature reserve section of the park, which has opened up natural wetland to the public.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The Mangroves have been made more accessible to visitors by the boardwalk built during the park's upgrade.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: You'd think that people would come here to look at the unusual plant life of the area, but in fact it's more often used for cycling and is very popular with the local clubs.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: This is the far end of the park and over there you can see the Frog Pond, a natural feature here long before the park was designed.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Just next to it we have our outdoor classroom, a favourite spot for school parties.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: The area is now most often used by primary schools for biology lessons.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: And finally let's pass by the Waterbird Refuge.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: This area is in a sheltered part of the estuary, that's why the park's viewing shelter is a favourite spot for bird watchers who can use it to spy through binoculars.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: You can watch a variety of water birds, but most visitors expect to see black swans when they come to the shelter.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: You might spot one yourself right now!

segments.speaker: SPEAKER
segments.en: Well, here we are back at our starting point, the Visitor Centre.
